_about: Build-side settings for The Hold. Nothing here is canon. Every value either points at canon (an entry id, a field, a pattern to find inside canon text) or is plain interface labelling. The importer reads this file and resolves each pointer against the snapshot; a pointer that no longer resolves is reported as a warning and left off the page.

scenes._about: Which Decision log stages are scenes. Stages with no recorded scene in canon/scenes.md are shown as missing.

tally._about: Figures on the front page. Each is read out of a canon field with a pattern; capture group 1 is the figure.

linking._about: How scene text is linked to entries. Entry titles and Cast names are matched automatically. Aliases cover words the Narrator uses for a thing whose entry has a different title. Each alias is a build decision, logged in BUILD_LOG.md.

uncertainty._about: Passages that rest on something no one in-world can check get a mark. Patterns are matched against scene paragraphs and entry fields; 'source' is quoted beside the mark's legend.
